title: Sturdy fabric and holds a lot.
text: Sturdy fabric and holds a lot.. These are very long and feels sturdy.  From reading the description I knew that they weren't going to be firm. They are a little difficult to shove under the bed because they're not on Wheels but for the price and the size of the bag it's worth it. I was able to get approximately 12 pairs of winter boots in one. I would definitely recommend.
